author: cens0r3d
install_msg:
Thank you for installing KickAlerts!

Setup: this cog talks to the external Kick.com API and needs OAuth2 credentials. Create them at https://kick.com/settings/developer, then run `[p]kickalert setcreds <client_id> <client_secret>` and `[p]kickalert authstatus` to verify.

Then pick an alert channel with `[p]kickalert setchannel #channel` and add streamers with `[p]kickalert add <username>`.

Data: guild settings (channel/role IDs, custom messages, poll interval, per-streamer config) and the Kick usernames you add are stored via Red's Config. Message content is not stored.
name: KickAlerts
short: Kick.com livestream announcements using the official Kick API v2.
description: Monitor Kick.com streamers using the official Kick API v2 with OAuth2 authentication. Get live notifications with beautiful embeds, viewer counts, categories, and more.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores guild-level configuration including channel IDs, role IDs, and Kick.com streamer usernames. API credentials are stored encrypted via Red's built-in token storage.
